data.title: As One
data.title_japanese: アズワン／AS ONE
data.synopsis:
The movie follows You, a high school student in modern-day Japan who dreams of becoming a musician but struggles with family opposition and conflicts within his band. One day, while walking through Shibuya, he hears a desperate voice calling for help, and a blinding white light engulfs him.

Meanwhile, far across the cosmos, the celestial body Meguriboshi is on the brink of war over the energy source known as "Hoshichi" (Star Blood). Just as a ceasefire is about to be negotiated between the warring nations, a massive orbital debris field descends, threatening disaster. Laco, a young mechanic, rushes to aid the planet's defense force but finds herself in grave danger. As she falls into unconsciousness, her mind connects with You's, marking the beginning of their intertwined fates.

(Source: MAL News)

data.synopsis:
Amane Kojou, a virgin girl frustrated with her chaste boyfriend who only kisses her, channels her energy into the track and field club. However, her strong sexual desire, typical of an athlete, fuels her growing frustration. To make matters worse, a middle-aged man can’t stop staring at her provocative athletic uniform.

Living alone in an apartment, Amane indulges in nightly masturbation. Unbeknownst to her, the middle-aged landlord secretly records her behavior!

In exchange for deleting the videos, he demands a one-sided physical relationship.

Though unwanted, Amane’s unsatisfied body begins to crave the man’s touch more and more… What will become of Amane?! 

(Source: AniDB)

data.synopsis:
Twenty years ago, numerous "Spiritual Ruins Gates" suddenly appeared all over the world. The spiritual energy gushing out of them would awaken the supernatural powers of those who came into contact with them. These people who awakened supernatural powers were called "Spirit Warriors". Among them, the "Space series" Spirit Warriors became the strongest because of their outstanding performance in the "Beast Tide Disaster" and the scarcity of their awakening. Jiang Nan grew up in an orphanage in Jiangcheng, Lingzhou. He aspired to become the top spiritual warrior since he was a child. At the age of sixteen, he awakened the strongest and rarest space-based supernatural power, becoming the second space-based supernatural power in Lingzhou. Our story begins here...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

titles.title: Whereabouts of Tomorrow: Ashita no Arika

data.title: Ashita no Arika
data.title_english: Whereabouts of Tomorrow: Ashita no Arika
data.title_japanese: あしたのありか
data.synopsis:
"Ever since that day...I lost hope for the future."

In 2021, Asumi, a salesperson at Kobe Steel, was having a difficult time finding meaning in her job while she felt helpless in the face of the company's numerous issues.

Just as Asumi was about to tell her boss that she wanted to quit, a mystical ray of light came out of a corporate history book and led her to Kobe in 1905. There she encountered visionary, high-spirited people from Kobe Steel's founding period. Torasuke was among them; he was a clumsy but enthusiastic young man from the Meiji era who dreamed big and believed in the potential of industrial development.

Guided by the Kobelco Group's history, two persons from different eras set out on a journey across time, from its beginning to the present.

They witness people get through tough times and continue to take on challenges with hope for a better future.

After coming into contact with the founders' spirits, they each choose their own path for the future.

(Source: Official site)
data.background: Ashita no Arika was released by Kobe Steel to celebrate the company's 120th anniversary.
